name: claude-rpg
description: Claude Code plugin marketplace for Claude RPG: development as a role-playing game. You are the Summoner, Claude is the Daemon; work is quests that run from scrying to a merged pull request, questlines for big goals, sidequests for what turns up on the way, subagent forks, a guard hook, and a pact that keeps the game out of your code, docs and pull requests.

plugins.name: rpg
plugins.description: Claude Code skills that run development as an RPG: /rpg:summon (survey a repository), /rpg:quest (scry, cast, trial, pull request, review, merge), /rpg:questline (a road of quests to one goal), /rpg:sidequest, /rpg:journal (status), /rpg:evocation (options when you are stuck). Subagent forks for parallel work, a PreToolUse guard hook against force pushes, evidence-tagged facts, plain professional output.
